title: Travelling to Markham for Root Canal Care: What to Know
metaTitle: Root Canal in Markham: A Guide for North York Patients
metaDescription: In North York and considering a root canal in Markham? Learn where the clinic is, how to plan your visits, what to bring, and what to expect afterward.
secondaryKeywords: root canal markham for north york
excerpt: A practical, honest guide for North York residents considering root canal care at a Markham clinic, including location and visit planning.
heroImageAlt: A welcoming dental clinic reception area in Markham, Ontario.
bodyHtml:
If you are in North York and considering a root canal in Markham, the main things to know are simple: the clinic is in Markham, not North York, so plan for the trip across the Greater Toronto Area; a root canal may take more than one visit, so factor in follow-up; and the final restoration, such as a crown, is part of completing your care. Many Markham practices welcome patients from across the GTA, including North York, and a little planning makes the experience straightforward.

Where the clinic is

Smile Dental Arts Centre is located at 3980 14th Ave #6, Markham, ON L3R 0B1, and can be reached by phone at (905) 604-7330. It is a general and family dental practice led by Dr. Neda Kadivar, who has over 20 years of experience and is a member of the Ontario Dental Association, the Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario, and the Canadian Dental Association. She provides root canal treatment at the clinic. If you are travelling from North York, it helps to confirm the address and parking or transit details before your first visit.

Planning your visits

Root canal treatment is sometimes completed in a single appointment and sometimes over two, depending on the tooth, its anatomy, and whether there is active infection. Because of this, it is wise to ask when you book how many visits are likely and roughly how long each will take, so you can plan your travel from North York accordingly. Keep in mind that neither single-visit nor multi-visit treatment is automatically better; the right approach depends on the tooth.

What to bring

  • Any recent X-rays or records from your current dentist.
  • A list of your medications, allergies, and relevant medical history.
  • Notes on your symptoms and any insurance or Canadian Dental Care Plan details.

Bringing your records can reduce repeated imaging and help the dentist assess your tooth efficiently on the first visit.

After your appointment

With local anesthetic, most people can drive themselves home after a root canal, though your mouth may stay numb for a while. If sedation is ever involved, you would need to arrange a ride. Plan for the possibility of mild soreness for a few days, which is normal, and make sure you know how to contact the clinic if you have questions once you are back home in North York.

Finishing the job

Completing care often means returning for a permanent restoration. Because this may involve another trip, ask the team to map out the full plan — the canal treatment, any temporary filling, and the final crown or filling — so you can schedule your visits with the travel in mind.

Making the trip easier

A little preparation goes a long way when you are travelling for care. Confirm your appointment time and the clinic's hours in advance, and give yourself a buffer so you are not rushing if traffic is heavier than expected. If possible, schedule your visit for a time of day that suits your energy and your commitments, since you may feel a little tired or numb afterward. It is also worth asking, when you book, whether anything specific is needed for a first appointment. Thinking through these practical details ahead of time means your focus on the day can be on your tooth and your questions, rather than on logistics.

Can I get a root canal in Markham if I live in North York?

Yes. Markham clinics commonly see patients from across the GTA. Just plan for the travel and any follow-up appointments.

How many trips should I expect?

Often one or two for the canal treatment, plus a visit for the final restoration. Ask your dentist to confirm what your specific tooth needs.

Who do I contact to arrange a visit?

You can reach the clinic directly by phone or through its website to ask questions and book a consultation.

To plan a visit from North York, you can learn more about Smile Dental Arts Centre and get in touch through the clinic's contact page to confirm directions, hours, and what to bring.

This article is general information and not a substitute for professional dental advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always speak with a licensed dentist about your specific situation.
